node.statement: Let c_bar be the coefficient supplied by lem-maincb-error-improvement and put c0=max{1,c_bar}. For each replacement map supplied there, its domain B is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra and its codomain A is the stated finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra. Since 0<=c_bar*epsilon<=c0*epsilon, lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone upgrades the replacement from an extended c_bar*epsilon-inclusion to an extended c0*epsilon-inclusion; if it was bijective it remains bijective. Hence c0>=1 is still a valid universal error-improvement witness.
